releases.headlineId: Pekan Doa Penatalayanan, program gereja offline, serta audit Notifikasi & Pengaturan
releases.headlineEn: Week of Prayer, offline church programs, and Notifications & Settings refinement
notesId: Pekan Doa Penatalayanan 2026 (Dewasa & Anak) hadir dengan 8 hari bacaan lengkap offline dalam Bahasa Indonesia dan Inggris, pelacakan progres, sorotan serta catatan paragraf, dan rujukan materi resmi.
Dasbor Hari Ini dan Kalender Gereja menampilkan program berlangsung maupun mendatang beserta pratinjau PDF serta penyimpanan materi program secara offline.

Menu Notifikasi kini difokuskan untuk menampilkan info terbaru, pembaruan materi, dan pengumuman agenda gereja; seluruh pengaturan dipindahkan ke Pengaturan dengan daftar kategori ringkas dan sub-halaman khusus.

Pengaturan Yang Baru di SabatKu dan Tentang Aplikasi kini menampilkan riwayat rilis 1.0.x serta terintegrasi dengan SabatKu Web, dilengkapi penyegaran dasbor (pull-to-refresh) dan penyempurnaan bacaan harian.
notesEn: Week of Prayer Stewardship 2026 (Adult & Children) brings 8 offline daily readings in Indonesian and English, progress tracking, paragraph highlights and notes, plus official material links.
The Today dashboard and Church Calendar highlight ongoing and upcoming programs with in-app PDF viewing and offline program material downloads.
The Notifications menu now focuses on latest info, content updates, and church agenda announcements, while all preferences live in a structured Settings list with dedicated sub-pages.
What's New and About pages in Settings now show 1.0.x release history and integrate directly with SabatKu Web, alongside Home pull-to-refresh and daily reading refinements.

releases.headlineEn: Google sign-in fix for Google Play
notesId: Konfigurasi masuk dengan Google disesuaikan dengan sertifikat aplikasi yang didistribusikan oleh Google Play.
Tombol Lanjutkan dengan Google membuka pemilih akun Google dengan opsi coba lagi atau lanjut tanpa akun bila pemilih gagal dibuka.
Daftar akun dan proses masuk berhasil diverifikasi pada perangkat uji setelah memperbarui ke 1.0.1 melalui Play Store.
notesEn: Google sign-in configuration aligned with the app signing certificate distributed by Google Play.
Continue with Google opens the account picker with clear retry and continue-without-account options if selection fails.
Account registration and Google sign-in verified on a test device after updating to 1.0.1 through Google Play.

releases.headlineId: Distribusi pengujian beralih ke Google Play
releases.headlineEn: Testing distribution moves to Google Play
notesId: Penguji terdaftar mulai memasang dan memperbarui SabatKu melalui Google Play Store menggunakan identitas aplikasi final id.sabatku.app.
Laporan pemilih akun Google dari rilis awal ini langsung ditangani pada pembaruan 1.0.1.
notesEn: Invited testers began installing and updating SabatKu through Google Play Store using the final application ID id.sabatku.app.
Account picker reports from this initial Play release were resolved in 1.0.1.

releases.headlineId: Pengalaman belajar harian dan persiapan Sabat yang lebih menyatu
releases.headlineEn: A more complete daily study and Sabbath experience
notesId: Beranda diperbarui agar pelajaran hari ini, ritme bacaan, dan waktu Sabat lebih mudah dipantau.
Sekolah Sabat, Alkitab, buku digital, dan PDF mendapat navigasi serta kontrol baca dan unduh yang lebih konsisten.
Pengingat bacaan, Doa 777, dan Sabat lebih tertata; pengalaman keluarga, privasi, pencadangan, dan sinkronisasi juga diperkuat.
notesEn: The Home screen makes today's lesson, reading rhythm, and Sabbath time easier to follow.
Sabbath School, Bible, digital books, and PDFs have more consistent navigation and reading and download controls.
Reading, Prayer 777, and Sabbath reminders are better organized, alongside stronger family, privacy, backup, and sync experiences.

releases.headlineId: Pengalaman Alkitab, pelajaran, dan PDF yang lebih nyaman
releases.headlineEn: A smoother Bible, lesson, and PDF experience
notesId: Pembaca Alkitab memudahkan pencarian dan perbandingan terjemahan, membuka materi terkait, serta kembali ke bacaan sebelumnya. Catatan dan sorotan lebih aman dicadangkan dan dipulihkan.
Unduh, perbarui, baca online, dan akses offline Sekolah Sabat kini lebih jelas. Unduhan PDF edisi penuh mencakup semua PDF pelajaran utama; pembaruan gagal mempertahankan salinan valid.
Zoom, geser halaman, dan layar penuh PDF disempurnakan. Status unduhan, progres belajar, serta navigasi bawah lebih jelas; Jelajahi lebih mudah dikenali.
notesEn: The Bible reader improves passage search, translation comparison, related material, and return navigation. Notes and highlights are safer to back up and restore.
Sabbath School download, update, online, and offline choices are clearer. A full-edition PDF download includes every main lesson PDF; failed updates keep the valid copy.
PDF zoom, page movement, and full-screen controls are improved. Download status, study progress, and bottom navigation are clearer, with Explore easier to identify.

releases.headlineId: Belajar bersama keluarga dan membaca buku lebih nyaman
releases.headlineEn: Family learning and a more comfortable book reader
notesId: Alive in Jesus kini mencakup pengalaman Baby Steps dan Beginner dalam Bahasa Indonesia, termasuk pendampingan orang tua, panduan guru, dan Parent Time Baby Steps untuk empat triwulan.
Kindergarten dan Primary memiliki alur belajar sesuai usia serta Junior PowerPoints dilengkapi ringkasan Power Text dan jawaban diskusi.
Halaman Sekolah Sabat, perpustakaan buku dengan daftar isi bertingkat, serta sinkronisasi Beranda dan pengingat diselaraskan.
notesEn: Alive in Jesus adds Indonesian Baby Steps and Beginner learning experiences, parent support, teacher guides, and Baby Steps Parent Time for all four quarters.
Kindergarten and Primary have age-appropriate learning flows, while Junior PowerPoints includes Power Text summaries and weekly discussion answers.
Sabbath School layout, hierarchical book contents, in-book search, and Home/reminder synchronization were improved.

releases.headlineId: Kindergarten, bacaan, sinkronisasi, dan pengingat Sabat
releases.headlineEn: Kindergarten, reading, sync, and Sabbath reminders
notesId: Alive in Jesus Kindergarten Triwulan IV 2026 berbahasa Indonesia tersedia dalam Panduan Murid dan Panduan Guru.
Pembaca buku, pelajaran, dan PDF mendapat kendali layar penuh dan toolbar yang lebih andal; sinkronisasi akun Google diperkuat.
notesEn: Alive in Jesus Kindergarten Q4 2026 is available in Indonesian with separate Student and Teacher Guides.
Book, lesson, and PDF readers add improved full-screen controls alongside safer Google account sync and reminder recovery.

notesId: Hadir widget layar utama (Ringkasan, Sekolah Sabat, Alkitab, Sabat), pengingat Sabat & Doa 777 dengan pilihan volume dan lagu, serta Alive in Jesus Primary.
notesEn: Added Home screen widgets (Overview, Sabbath School, Bible, Sabbath), strengthened Sabbath & Prayer 777 reminders, and introduced Alive in Jesus Primary.

releases.headlineId: Pembaruan materi, aktivitas interaktif, dan pembaca PDF
releases.headlineEn: Lesson updates, interactive activities, and PDF reading
notesId: Revisi per pelajaran, pemulihan aktivitas interaktif Real-Time Faith offline, urutan kelas, kontrol PDF, pemuatan sampul, dan navigasi perpustakaan disempurnakan.
notesEn: Lesson-level revisions, offline Real-Time Faith activity recovery, class ordering, PDF controls, cover loading, and library navigation were improved.

releases.headlineId: Bacaan lebih nyaman, kalender gereja, dan pembaruan aplikasi lebih aman
releases.headlineEn: Comfortable reading, church calendar, and safer app updates
notesId: Penyempurnaan dasbor terjadwal, Renungan Harian, Kalender Gereja 2026, Peraturan Jemaat offline, serta pemeriksaan integritas APK GitHub Releases.
notesEn: Improved scheduled dashboard readings, Daily Devotional, 2026 Church Calendar, offline Church Manual, and integrity-verified app updates.

notesId: Bacaan terjadwal, kendali tampilan bacaan, kalender gereja, pengingat Sabat, dan Doa 777 disempurnakan.
notesEn: Scheduled readings, reading controls, church calendar, Sabbath reminders, and Prayer 777 were improved.

releases.headlineId: Materi belajar lengkap offline & perpustakaan buku digital
releases.headlineEn: Offline companion study library & digital books
notesId: Materi Sekolah Sabat offline beserta Penuntun Guru, aktivitas interaktif Cornerstone, perpustakaan buku digital, dan mekanisme pembaruan dalam aplikasi.
notesEn: Added offline Sabbath School companion materials, interactive Cornerstone activities, digital book library, and in-app update notifications.

notesId: Buka Penuntun Guru mingguan yang sesuai langsung dari setiap pelajaran siswa, baca pendahuluan triwulan secara terpisah, dan simpan offline.
notesEn: Open the matching weekly teacher guide from each student lesson, read quarterly introductions separately, and save for offline access.

notesId: Alkitab TB dan KJV offline, Sekolah Sabat Indonesia/Inggris berbagai kelas dan bacaan pendamping dewasa, waktu Sabat & kartu Sabat, serta profil belajar dan sinkronisasi Google opsional.
notesEn: Offline TB and KJV Bible, bilingual Sabbath School with adult companion guides, local Sabbath countdowns and reminders, and personal learning profiles with optional Google sync.
releases.summaryNoteId: Ringkasan retrospektif fitur sepanjang pra-rilis perdana beta01 hingga beta07.
releases.summaryNoteEn: Retrospective summary of capabilities developed across beta01 through beta07.
